rules.rationale: Always blocks — no results without origin
Strongest explicit signal — route verification primary
Total cost is primary need — replaces card grid at slot 3
Default discovery — shown unless higher-weight rule displaces
Trip length changes total cost significantly — show after budget matrix
Supporting flight detail — after destination card
Dates open — help user pick best month
Companion type modifies card slot content — tag + match row variant
Always after results — never displaces explicit content

slotRules.name: Vibe tags
slotRules.content: Tags filtered by query signals. weather → temperature tag. quiet → Hidden gem. budget → value tag. dealNightlife → Nightlife scene. dealNature → Nature access. solo → Solo-friendly. couple → Romantic base. family → Family-friendly.

slotRules.name: Why it's a match — row 1
slotRules.content: "Low tourist level in [month]" — ordered FIRST when signal present

slotRules.name: Why it's a match — row 2
slotRules.content: "Expect drier weather in [month]" — ordered after quiet row if both present
slotRules.order: Position 1 if only weather · position 2 if quiet also present

slotRules.name: Why it's a match — dealbreaker row
slotRules.content: "Great nightlife scene" or "Strong hiking access" — shown when dealbreaker signal present

slotRules.name: Why it's a match — companion row
slotRules.content: "Great for solo travellers" / "Romantic neighbourhood base" / "Excellent family beaches" — companion type variant

slotRules.name: Why it's a match — fallback row
slotRules.content: "Best of both: [destination characteristic]" — always present, always fills final slot

slotRules.name: Flight price section
slotRules.content: "[Month] flights from £[price] per traveller · [X]hr [Y]m typical flight time"
